name: 60602 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60602 (Chicago) has 287 nonprofit organizations. 119 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 99 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60602 (Chicago) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60602 (Chicago) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 13.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 99 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.
